artworks.title: Vertumnus and Pomona

artworks.title: Landscape with Vertumnus and Pomona
artworks.description: Bloemaert's landscape — Vertumnus and Pomona small in a Dutch orchard world, Metamorphoses Book 14 as pastoral.

artworks.title: Vertumnus and Pomona
artworks.description: Eeckhout, Rembrandt's pupil, paints Pomona half-turned toward the god's disguise — soft Dutch light on Ovid's autumn romance. Google Art Project scan of the orchard pair.

popCulture.title: Metamorphoses
popCulture.creator: Ovid
popCulture.description: Book 14 — Vertumnus as an old crone telling Pomona the tale of Iphis, until the disguise falls and the orchard yields.

popCulture.title: Pomona
popCulture.description: The hamadryad of fruit trees — Rome's orchard goddess, still the name for gardens and autumn abundance.
